description: Source code for the SQL store implementation of plugin key-value management in Mattermost, including methods for saving, updating, comparing, deleting, and listing plugin key-values.

classes.name: SqlPluginStore
classes.description: Struct implementing plugin key-value store operations backed by SQL database.

methods.name: SaveOrUpdate
methods.description: Inserts or updates a plugin key-value pair in the database.

methods.name: CompareAndSet
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-set operation on a plugin key-value.

methods.name: CompareAndDelete
methods.description: Deletes a plugin key-value if the current value matches the expected old value.

methods.name: SetWithOptions
methods.description: Sets a plugin key-value with additional options, optionally atomically.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin key-value by plugin ID and key.

methods.name: DeleteAllForPlugin
methods.description: Deletes all key-values associated with a plugin.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists plugin keys with pagination, filtering by expiration.
